# `template`

What a kind of thing is made of: a body, stats, tags, rules, starting traits and items, and choices (06 §10).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `kind` (string, or `null`; optional): A free-form label: `species`, `background`, whatever content calls it.
- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `body` (id of a [`body_plan`](body_plan.md), or `null`; optional): The body plan a thing made from it is built from. A later template's replaces an earlier one's.
- `glyph` (object [`GlyphDef`](#glyphdef), or `null`; optional): How it is drawn. A later template's replaces an earlier one's.
- `remains` (string, or `null`; optional): What is left of a body destroyed entirely (06 §7.5), by id, as written: for whoever makes remains.
- `blocks` (`true` or `false`, or `null`; optional): Whether a thing made from it blocks movement through its cell (06 §11). Default true for one with a body.
- `choices` (list of object [`ChoiceDef`](#choicedef); optional): The choices made within it.
- `know_how` (list of string; optional): Know-how a thing made from it knows (16 §8.5), by id as written: given to its mind when it is made, without asking what each needs.
- `groups` (object, name → string; optional): The groups a thing made from it joins (15 §9.2), by id, each with its role there, `""` for none: joined openly, with `group_joined`, when `entity_spawned` is delivered.
- `attributes` (object, id of a [`attribute`](attribute.md) → number; optional): Bases of its own for attributes. A later contribution replaces an earlier one's.
- `pools` (list of id of a [`pool`](pool.md); optional): Pools it is given, at their definitions' `start`.
- `tracks` (object, id of a [`track`](track.md) → number; optional): What each track starts with: added to its counter.
- `tags` (list of string; optional): Tags of the entity.
- `variables` (object, name → [expression](../values.md#expressions); optional): Variables of the entity and their values: constant expressions.
- `rules` (list of id of a [`eoc`](eoc.md); optional): Rules attached to the entity (05 §9.3).
- `traits` (list of string; optional): Traits it starts with, by id, as written: given by whoever gives traits (06 §5), who is told of them by `entity_spawned`.
- `abilities` (list of string; optional): Abilities it is given, by id, as written, with the template as their source (08 §3.3): it holds them until they are revoked.
- `items` (list of string; optional): What it starts with, by the id of an item or a content table, as written: made by the item package (06 §9), which is told of them by `entity_spawned`.
- `scale` (number, or `null`; optional): A factor on the body's size.
- `mind` ([`MindField`](#mindfield), or `null`; optional): A mind, none, or a behaviour profile.
- `senses` (list of string; optional): Senses it is given (15 §4), by id as written: given when it is made, where perception's definitions are loaded.

<a id="glyphdef"></a>
### `GlyphDef`

How a thing made from a template is drawn (12 §4): one character and its colours, as the presentation names them. The engine keeps them and gives them no meaning.

- `ch` (string; **required**): The character.
- `fg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour of the character, by name.
- `bg` (string, or `null`; optional): The colour behind it, by name.

<a id="choicedef"></a>
### `ChoiceDef`

One choice of a template (06 §10.2).

- `id` (string; **required**): Its id within the template, or within the option it sits in.
- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `kind` (one of `"pick"`, `"points"`, `"range"`, `"text"`, `"assemble"` ([`ChoiceKind`](#choicekind)); **required**): What sort of choice it is.
- `count` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): For `pick`: how many options are picked. Default 1.
- `budget` (number, or `null`; optional): For `points` and `assemble`: what may be spent.
- `options` (list of object [`OptionDef`](#optiondef); optional): For `pick` and `points`: the options.
- `min` (number, or `null`; optional): For `range`: the least and the most the number may be.
- `max` (number, or `null`; optional): For `range`: the most the number may be.
- `max_length` (whole number, 0 or more, or `null`; optional): For `text`: the most characters it takes.
- `suggestions` (list of string; optional): For `text`: what a random choice picks from.
- `parts` (list of id of a [`body_part`](body_part.md); optional): For `assemble`: the parts that may be added.
- `sets` (one of `"scale"`, `"name"`, `"description"` ([`Sets`](#sets)), or `null`; optional): For `range` and `text`: what the value does.
- `attribute` (id of a [`attribute`](attribute.md), or `null`; optional): For `range`: the attribute whose base the value becomes.
- `default` ([`ChoiceDefault`](#choicedefault), or `null`; optional): What is chosen when nobody chooses.

<a id="mindfield"></a>
### `MindField`

What a template or an option says about a mind (06 §8.1): `true` for a mind with no behaviour profile, `false` for none, or the id of a behaviour profile for the AI layer (09), kept as written.

Takes:

- a string
- a boolean

<a id="choicekind"></a>
### `ChoiceKind`

The kinds of choice (06 §10.2).

One of:

- `"pick"`: Picks `count` of the listed options.
- `"points"`: Spends a `budget` on the listed options, each at its `cost`.
- `"range"`: Sets a number between `min` and `max`.
- `"text"`: Types something.
- `"assemble"`: Adds parts from an allowed set, one point of the `budget` each.

<a id="optiondef"></a>
### `OptionDef`

One option of a `pick` or `points` choice: whatever a template gives, and choices of its own.

- `id` (string; **required**): Its id within the choice.
- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a reader calls it.
- `cost` (number, or `null`; optional): What it costs from a `points` budget. Default 1.
- `choices` (list of object [`ChoiceDef`](#choicedef); optional): Choices that open once it is chosen.
- `attributes` (object, id of a [`attribute`](attribute.md) → number; optional): Bases of its own for attributes. A later contribution replaces an earlier one's.
- `pools` (list of id of a [`pool`](pool.md); optional): Pools it is given, at their definitions' `start`.
- `tracks` (object, id of a [`track`](track.md) → number; optional): What each track starts with: added to its counter.
- `tags` (list of string; optional): Tags of the entity.
- `variables` (object, name → [expression](../values.md#expressions); optional): Variables of the entity and their values: constant expressions.
- `rules` (list of id of a [`eoc`](eoc.md); optional): Rules attached to the entity (05 §9.3).
- `traits` (list of string; optional): Traits it starts with, by id, as written: given by whoever gives traits (06 §5), who is told of them by `entity_spawned`.
- `abilities` (list of string; optional): Abilities it is given, by id, as written, with the template as their source (08 §3.3): it holds them until they are revoked.
- `items` (list of string; optional): What it starts with, by the id of an item or a content table, as written: made by the item package (06 §9), which is told of them by `entity_spawned`.
- `scale` (number, or `null`; optional): A factor on the body's size.
- `mind` ([`MindField`](#mindfield), or `null`; optional): A mind, none, or a behaviour profile.
- `senses` (list of string; optional): Senses it is given (15 §4), by id as written: given when it is made, where perception's definitions are loaded.

<a id="sets"></a>
### `Sets`

What a `range` or `text` choice's value does to the thing made.

One of:

- `"scale"`: For `range`: the body's size is multiplied by the value.
- `"name"`: For `text`: the value is the thing's own name.
- `"description"`: For `text`: the value is the thing's own description.

<a id="choicedefault"></a>
### `ChoiceDefault`

A choice's default: what is chosen when nobody chooses. Its shape depends on the kind: option ids for `pick`, `points` and `assemble`, a number for `range`, a text for `text`.

Takes:

- a string
- an integer
- a number
- a list: list of string
